lines.1: 「Otome! I had a question about how to polish the floor.」
lines.8: I couldn't let her intimidate me now.
lines.10: 「You appear to be studying a remarkably unconventional form of architecture.」
lines.11: I never expected the camouflage to make her more curious.
lines.12: 「Still, you are a boy of that age. I suppose it cannot be helped.」
lines.13: She smiled like a merciful bodhisattva.
lines.15: 「--Did you think I would say that?」
lines.17: 「The contents are too vile to look upon. Filthy.」
lines.19: She looked at me with contempt.
lines.21: 「Fukahire's room is so rotten that no matter where he reaches, his hand lands on an adult magazine!」
lines.24: 「I cannot understand a book filled with women entangled with other women. It is unproductive and therefore unacceptable.」
lines.27: 「What is this? The pages are glued together.」
lines.31: Who gets someone else's book dirty like that?!
lines.33: 「There is no need to tell me. I would never read such a thing.」
lines.34: 「As punishment, one lap around the neighborhood.」
lines.37: 「I-I will complete one lap around the neighborhood, ma'am!」
